questions: When moving stones from bag A to bag B, must the number of stones moved be a positive integer (i.e., at least one stone), or can it be zero (a no-op)?
Are we allowed to move stones from a bag to itself? If so, does that count as an operation?
Can we move more stones from bag A than are currently in bag A (i.e., can we have negative stones in a bag)?
Is the order of bags considered for the XOR? That is, is the XOR taken over the sequence (B_1, B_2, ..., B_N) as labeled, or over the multiset of values regardless of labels?

Are the bags distinguishable for the purpose of counting 'different possible values'? For example, if swapping contents between two bags yields the same XOR but different per-bag values, does that count as the same value?
Can we move stones from bag B to bag A in the same operation, or is the operation strictly one-directional (from A to B)?
Is there any limit on the number of stones that can be in a bag after operations (e.g., capacity constraints)?
Does the operation require that bags A and B be distinct?
